name: Mine Exploration
description: Infiltrate the Forgotten Mines (Ancient Mine) and explore it at least once.

narrative.accept: Grim the Prospector looks worried. "The Forgotten Mines have been overrun with dangerous crystals and golems. Can you map the depths?"
narrative.complete: "You survived the descent! Here is your share of the bounty."
narrative.hint: Travel to Forgotten Mines and explore it.
